messages:
maya: Heads-up - AMS region showing sustained GPU allocation failures since 14:03 UTC. A couple customer pools hit 503s.
ashwin: I see spike in allocation errors: `cuda-init-timeout` across thin pool nodes. Rolling repro on staging looked similar after kubelet restart.
liam: Can we divert traffic now? I can push weighted routing to avoid AMS. :thinking_face:
sara: +1, shift non-critical traffic first. Keep dedicated/reserved for enterprise customers.
maya: Action: start progressive weight shift to other EU edge (AMS->LON). Liam, can you apply weights? I'll coordinate on contacts.
liam: Doing it now. Rolling in 10% steps via the traffic-controller API. Cmd: `curl -X POST /v1/route/weight -d '{"from":"ams","to":"lon","pct":10}'`
ops-bot: deploy:traffic-controller v2.14 applied by liam at 14:12 UTC :white_check_mark:
ashwin: While shifting, I want to confirm the root cause: kernel OOM killers observed on some GPUs during driver restart. Might be provisioning race with our device-plugin.
devon: Noted. I'm seeing failed kubelet healthchecks on two node groups in ams-edge-7. Marking them cordon/drain.
sara: Please only drain non-reserved pools. We need to keep enterprise SLA traffic pinned.
devon: Doing conservative drain: `kubectl cordon gpux-ams-7a && kubectl drain gpux-ams-7a --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`
liam: Weight shift 10% -> 20% -> 40% -> 60% in 5m intervals. Monitoring latency and error rate.
maya: Ops checklist update suggestion: add explicit step to check `nvidia-device-plugin` rollout status and `dmesg` for OOM logs before mass draining. We don't have that in runbook currently.
ashwin: Agreed. Also add a pre-shift cost assessment note: multi-region shift increases egress and cross-region model warmup cost. Flag to product/cost.
sara: We lost ~7% throughput on the first 20% shift but errors dropped to baseline. Keep going.
liam: Reached 60%. Error rate down ~92%. Latency stable.
devon: After drain, I'm reprovisioning fresh nodes with a slightly higher kubelet grace period and driver restart delay. Patch: `KUBELET_EXTRA_ARGS=--node-status-update-frequency=10s` (temporary).
maya: Good. Capture that tweak in runbook as an emergency knob — owner: devon, ETA: tomorrow EOD.
ashwin: For the runbook language, propose a short triage checklist at top: 1) Is allocation failing? 2) Check device-plugin and driver logs 3) Decide: drain vs weight-shift 4) Cost/SLAs 5) Post-mortem tags.
liam: I'll draft the checklist PR. Also add a small snippet to do weighted shifts via `traffic-controller` CLI. Code sample: ```bash
# shift 30% from ams to lon
trafficctl shift --from ams --to lon --pct 30 --step 10 --wait 300
```
sara: Add owner tags to each checklist item (oncall, infra, product-cost). We want no ambiguous responsibilities during incidents.
ops-bot: incident:ticket #INC-4321 created by maya - "AMS GPU allocation failures" - priority P1
maya: Post-incident action items so far: (1) runbook checklist PR — liam, (2) device-plugin hardening + driver restart delay — devon, (3) cost impact analysis for cross-region warmups — ashwin, (4) add automated pre-shift gating to console that warns about estimated egress/cold-start cost — sara.
ashwin: I'll start the cost analysis and add a quick chart of expected token/egress delta for 10/30/60% shifts.
devon: I'll open a mini RFC for kubelet/driver knobs and add automated health check script that runs: ```bash
# quick health checks for GS nodes
docker logs nvidia-device-plugin | tail -n 200
dmesg | grep -i oom
kubectl get nodes -l pool=thin-pool -o wide
```
liam: Drafted checklist PR and small console gating UI copy. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1209 (WIP).
sara: We should add a short emergency mitigation: if weight-shift doesn't reduce errors in 15m, escalate to cross-region replay disable for non-critical customers. Add exact command to disable replay.
maya: Agree. Put explicit escalation timeline in runbook: 5m detect, 10m minor shift, 25m escalate to cross-region replay disable, 40m exec full failover.
ashwin: Note for postmortem: investigate provisioning race introduced in last driver-rollout (2026-03-10). Correlate rollout timeline with node boot logs.
liam: I'll follow-up tomorrow with final PR and link to incident metrics.
maya: Thanks team. Postmortem + runbook PRs expected by EOD tomorrow. Leaving this thread open for updates. :raised_hands:
